en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad and Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, altogether from Ibn Mahboub, from Ali Bin Raib, from Abu Baseer who said,

‘I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about the man who happened to have the slave girl between them. So, one of them emancipated his share. So the slave girl said to the one who did not emancipate, ‘Do not seek me. Evaluate me and leave me as if I am your servant’. What is your<sup>asws</sup> view if the one who did not emancipate the other half, intends to sleep with her. Would that be for him?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It is not befitting for him that he does that, because there do not happen to be two private parts for the woman, alothough it is not befitting for him that he make her serve, but he should make her serve. So, if she were to refuse, there would be a day for herself, and a day for him’.
